timingPolicy.activeCodyWork: Only active investigation, judgment, authority packaging, registration orchestration, validation, and reporting.
timingPolicy.permissionEnvironmentFriction: Preserved separately and excluded from active work.
timingPolicy.unattendedWaiting: Network transfer and automated lifecycle execution wait preserved separately and excluded from active work.

segments.workPerformed: Read the governed command, constrained execution to Command 1, inspected the frozen baseline, and anchored the experiment.
segments.cause: Population, architecture, and timing boundaries had to be fixed before catalog contact.
segments.futureReduction: Standard stress-test initiation metadata can be prepackaged.

segments.workPerformed: Queried the publisher Store API and publication API, crawled all 22 live shop pages, and reconciled 258 published products with 256 public shop-grid products.
segments.cause: The complete current publisher denominator and hidden-from-grid records had to be established authoritatively.
segments.futureReduction: A publisher catalog snapshot adapter can reconcile API, publication, and storefront visibility automatically.

segments.workPerformed: Downloaded and hashed one GunFun-hosted publisher representation for every SKU; packaged exact product identity, categories, descriptions, dimensions, publication state, and provenance.
segments.cause: Registration and asset admission require immutable publisher-derived identity and evidence.
segments.futureReduction: A governed publisher-profile importer can package product and asset authority directly from the frozen snapshot.

segments.workPerformed: Applied the lowest truthful UGO boundary: normalized source-image evidence only, with canonical regions, semantics, physical measurement, correction, and inferred target meaning unavailable.
segments.cause: Publisher images and dimensions do not establish rectified shooter-photo geometry or semantic region authority.
segments.futureReduction: The frozen smart-evidence geometry component already eliminates per-target geometry work at this capability boundary.

segments.workPerformed: Reused 12 approved Batch 2 contracts and generated 225 governed registration contracts from catalog authority; no target-ID production source, module, route, branch, or allowlist was created.
segments.cause: Each publisher relationship still requires immutable product identity, asset hash, component bindings, and unavailable states.
segments.futureReduction: A governed contract-packaging owner can emit these records directly from approved catalog authority.

segments.workPerformed: Validated resolver and assets, exercised 237 backend lifecycles and 237 real browser lifecycles through exact reopen, then ran scale, family, Session Authority, preservation, Vital Dude, Baker SL-ST1, Universal SEC, and build regressions.
segments.cause: Catalog-wide inheritance and preservation claims required execution evidence rather than registry presence alone.
segments.futureReduction: The full-catalog lifecycle harness can become a standard publisher regression suite.

segments.workPerformed: Diagnosed that the preexisting static Vital Dude Session Authority profile resolves before the frozen contract resolver, shadowing a contract with the established target profile ID; removed the attempted contract and recorded the architecture failure without a workaround.
segments.cause: Legacy target-specific admission precedence conflicts with registration-driven resolution for the same governed identity.
segments.futureReduction: A separately approved migration/precedence rule can let an established target identity adopt a TEC without duplicate routes or target-ID bypasses.

segments.workPerformed: Handled sandbox-local socket bind/connect denials by using the approved local review permissions; no Founder interruption occurred.
segments.cause: Local review ports required environment permission outside the default sandbox network boundary.
segments.futureReduction: A preapproved local-review command family or in-process browser harness would remove the repeated local socket admission.

segments.workPerformed: Reconciled denominator metrics, exception classes, architecture and QR-route percentages, timing, and final governed report.
segments.cause: The experiment requires an auditable answer about where every catalog product stopped and why.
segments.futureReduction: The audit and lifecycle outputs can produce this report mechanically.
